name: StockLab Data Acquisition Contract
principle: A verified snapshot is not a data source and is never a substitute for missing data.

states.verified_snapshot_reuse: Reuse is allowed only when the snapshot represents the same registered dataset/field/period or trading session, remains within its explicit validity window, and already passed licence, source, schema, date and integrity checks.
states.licensed_source_fetch: If no valid verified snapshot exists, the acquisition pipeline may fetch only from a registered legally permitted source. The newly fetched data must pass all validation gates before any model may consume it.
states.unavailable: If acquisition fails, the source is legally unusable, the schema is unknown, the date/period is wrong, fields are missing, or validation fails, the value remains unavailable and dependent conclusions are blocked.

absolute_prohibitions: Do not use a previous trading session or previous reporting period as a replacement for a missing current required input.
Do not convert unknown or missing values to zero.
Do not fabricate, interpolate, estimate or infer an observed official field.
Do not use a model estimate as though it were observed market data.
Do not switch to an unregistered provider merely because the registered source failed.
Do not treat a stale snapshot as current.
Do not calculate a prediction when any required critical input is unavailable.
Do not label a retained snapshot as a live/current quote unless the underlying licensed feed actually supports that claim.
decision_rule: verified required inputs -> calculate; otherwise -> no result
ui_rule: When blocked, show which required input is unavailable and why. Never show a numeric placeholder that could be mistaken for real data.
